caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal box with a rounded lid that is partially open, revealing the interior. The box is predominantly black, with the front surface decorated with a floral pattern featuring red, yellow, and blue flowers and green leaves, as well as small red circular elements. The lid has a gold-colored handle, and a decorative gold pattern runs along the top edge. There is a metallic latch in the center of the front of the lid. The background is a plain, off-white color with some scattered minor stains or marks. The artist's name and date are inscribed in small text at the lower right corner.
title: Lunch Box
